description: Check the status of a custom quote request or order by its reference. Returns its status (received, acknowledged, quoted or closed), the timestamps for each step, the reply-by time, its history and the firm quote once issued. Example input: {"reference":"Q-ABC123"}.

reference.description: The Q- or E- reference returned by request_quote, e.g. Q-ABC123.

name: rush_order_status
title: Check quote request or order status
